verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs say Financial Connections can access account owners' names and mailing addresses. They also position it to mitigate fraud by verifying account ownership details, and document an ownership-refresh webhook, so the core retrieve-and-match use case is first-party documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of contact data (email/phone) on file at the bank, documented matching/comparison tooling or field-level detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration of ownership data retrieval.
